The '''Tower of Valni''' (Japanese: {{hl|ヴェルニの塔|Veruni no tō}} ''Tower of Velni'') is a map location in {{FE8}} that is unlocked after completing [[It's a Trap!|Chapter&nbsp;8]]. The tower consists of eight different floors in which the player fights against various monsters. Completing the tower during the [[Creature Campaign]] unlocks five bonus characters: [[Caellach]], [[Orson]], [[Riev]], [[Ismaire]], and [[Selena (The Sacred Stones)|Selena]].

On higher floors of the tower, there are chests with [[Weapon level|D-level]] items and [[gold]], which tends to make up for the broken weapons lost during battles. In addition, the last [[boss]], a [[Cyclops]], has a chance to drop a valuable stat boosting item or a [[Master Seal]].

==Trivia==
* If one looks through ''The Sacred Stones'' text files, there are text labels for a ninth and tenth floor of the Tower of Valni.
* In the [[Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones prototype|prototype of ''The Sacred Stones'']], the tower was called the {{hl|バレアルの塔|Barearu no tō}} ''Tower of Baleal''.
